completed_bar_audit.domain: Every completed hourly causal feature timestamp inside each effective operational membership interval.
completed_bar_audit.signal_rule: SIGNAL when at least one A2 selected_pre_router candidate exists at the completed bar; otherwise NO_SIGNAL.

legacy_control.p3r_hash_erratum: P3R recorded ledger hashes are metadata-unreproducible from the documented contract; the committed erratum is accepted only when upstream P3R, strategy logic and market data are unchanged.

membership_repair.actual_unavailable_interval_policy: Replace a selected member only when it lacks a GENERATED partition. A generated member with zero completed causal feature bars remains selected and contributes an empty audit domain; zero bars are not data unavailability.
membership_repair.single_omission_readiness_policy: Resolve each LOAO omission deterministically. Use the highest-ranked interval-ready GENERATED nonmember when one exists; otherwise the counterfactual remains ready at reduced capacity. BCHSV-USDT and PEPE-USDT require actual interval-ready replacements.

objective: Adopt the already-passed bounded six-symbol control regeneration under the RD16L local-ledger hash authority, repair members lacking GENERATED partitions deterministically, and materialize exactly one SIGNAL or NO_SIGNAL decision for every completed causal feature bar of every effective C2, D2 and E2 member. Generated zero-bar membership intervals are valid empty audit domains.
